title: JESUS IS THE ANSWER

lines.text: Jesus is the answer for the world today,
If you have any questions in the corners of your mind,
Seem to face you day by day,
Theres one thing Im sure of:
That you think you cannot climb,
I know your skies are dark you think
But the Word of God is true,
He will do it for you.

lyrics:
[Chorus]
 Jesus is the answer for the world today,
Above Him theres no other
For Jesus is the way. (Repeat)
[Verse]
[Verse]
If you have any questions in the corners of your mind,
Traces of discouragement,
Peace you cannot find,
Reflections of your past
Seem to face you day by day,
Theres one thing Im sure of:
Jesus is the way.
[Verse]
[Verse]
I know youve got mountains
That you think you cannot climb,
I know your skies are dark you think
The sun wont shine.
In case you dont know,
But the Word of God is true,
And everything Hes promised,
He will do it for you.
